title: Failure bits for a finite family
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\mathcal{F}$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. If the confidence parameter is $1/(10|\mathcal{F}|)$, then the number of failure bits is $\lceil\log_2(20|\mathcal{F}|)\rceil$, where this expression is interpreted as the least integer $k$ with $2^k\ge 20|\mathcal{F}|$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal{F}$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
